name: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie lengthwise on a flat bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell shoulder-width apart above your chest.
Set a slight bend in your elbows, tuck your ribs down, and brace your core.
Lower the bar slowly in a wide arc behind your head until your upper arms line up near your ears.
Pull the bar smoothly back over your chest along the same arc using your lats.
tips: Keep your rib cage tucked down so your lower back does not arch sharply as you reach back.
Maintain the same slight elbow angle rather than bending and extending your elbows.
